Name: Foraging Wild Eggs
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
So this mod pretty much spawns wild eggs all over Stardew!

I've provided photos of what the egg looks like and places possibly where they can spawn.

Can spawn 1-4 eggs per location between 0600-1800 game time. (you can also customize as you like in the config.json file in the FTM folder).

It spawns at the bus stop, mountains, beach, town, forest, backwoods, it is also possible to dig for them as well.

Also included:
Wild Egg Mayo- Made in the mayonnaise machine  (200 mins)  *takes 1 egg to make*
Pickled Wild Eggs- Made in the Preserves Jar (450 mins) *takes 2 eggs to make*

Let me know what else items you would like to see spawned. I love everything forage!

How To Download:

1. Download Wild Egg mod here from Nexus.
2. Extract wild egg into mods folder. 
3. Have Fun!
